item.title: Kafka Quickstart
item.description:
In this lab, you will have the opportunity to install Kafka with one of its simplest configurations. This installation is not optimized for production environments, but rather is ideal for quick and local development purposes. This sandboxing setup is often just what you need for quick experimentation and developing other services that will communicate with Kafka.

Apache Kafka is a framework implementation of a software bus using stream processing. It is an open source software platform developed by the Apache Software Foundation and written in Scala and Java. The project aims to provide a unified, high-throughput, low-latency platform for handling real-time data feeds.
